reviewer: Codex manual visual inspection of approved references and actual fixed-camera neutral/blink/gaze renders

criteria.reason: Separate volumetric globe, annular iris, pupil and cornea meshes have frozen sphere-center pivots and no eye-layer surface intersections. Actual +/-12-degree aim probes preserve child placement and clearance.

Front and 3/4 comparisons retain the logo-governed bright cream face around the two large cyan/blue eyes. Thick annular openings replace closed coarse lobes; actual BVH pair checks find no mask intersection with either eye or the beak.

Forty-one mesh states are closed and free of self intersections; every rendered lid triangle clears the cornea by at least 1.0248 mm. At full closure front/back seams coincide exactly and 10,034 rays cover both complete cornea apertures. Front, profile and 3/4 views show a contact seam without exposed iris.

All four fixed reference comparisons preserve frozen eye spacing/depth, large attentive eyes, cream mask, orange beak and the unchanged body/head silhouette. Back shows no eye protrusion; profile and 3/4 expose real depth. Final gloss/network motifs and feather layers remain explicitly deferred.

limits: Diagnostic matte eye colors and transparent cornea; final shaders/network motifs deferred.
All-quad spherical lid probe construction; final animatable controls and head attachment deferred.
Visible canthus/closed contact seams are intentional; facial feather groups follow later.
